name: BloodBowl_Card
cardText: Dirty Player, Dodge, Loner (4+), Pogo, Right Stuff, Sprint, Stunty, Sure Feet
specialRules: Yoink!: Once per game, when Scrappa attempts to Intercept a Pass Action he may roll a D6. On a 2+, Scrappa doesn’t need to roll to Intercept; instead, he will automatically Intercept the Pass Action and gains control of the ball.
